en.about: I design and build solid cloud infrastructure and modern web products. I work on AWS architecture, migrations and serverless platforms, and build web applications with Vue.js and TypeScript. I take projects from analysis and design to release and operations, and I enjoy solving problems end to end. I also build with AI tools such as Claude Code, using agentic workflows and custom skills.

experience.title: Cloud Engineer
bullets: Worked on an e-learning platform based on Moodle, owning the project end to end: customer management, analysis, design, implementation and testing.
Built the platform's infrastructure and its releases, including the golden AMI pipeline with EC2 Image Builder.

Ran AWS assessments and Migration Acceleration Program (MAP) engagements for several customers: discovery of their environments on other cloud providers or on premises, inventory and metrics collection, and migration proposals to AWS (lift and shift, replatform, optimized) with cost estimates and migration waves.

experience.title: Cloud Developer
experience.intro: Software development in the Cloud Security Team, integrating cloud technologies and security practices. I independently managed:
bullets: Refactoring of a welfare service after a data breach: data partitioning and isolation, application code, authorization policies, the migration from Amplify to Terraform and release automation with AWS CodePipeline.

A multi-tenant security assessment platform on AWS serverless services: a SaaS portal for clients, an admin portal for tenants and users, and the backend services for authentication, authorization and management.
A data synchronization solution on AWS serverless services that automates the synchronization of two asset inventories.
A training course on Amazon API Gateway for 15 to 20 participants, with slides, interactive demos and real-world use cases.
Sumo Logic parsers and log mapping for security monitoring, and Visual Basic scripts for identity management workflows on the One Identity platform.

experience.title: Cloud Developer

bullets: Led the design and implementation of a single sign-on platform for multiple applications, from the production release through its maintenance.
Developed an order management system: backend services and web applications for order processing and tracking.
Contributed to a satellite-based tolling system, implementing geofencing and toll calculation.

education.title: Computer Science
bullets: Operating systems, networking, software engineering, imperative and declarative programming.

Projects: an Android app for subscription management, a JSON parser library in Prolog and Common Lisp, a backend service with a custom Redis implementation in Java, and a relational database in MySQL.
